headline: Your business. Your people. Worth looking after.
prompt: Create a finished premium portrait 4:5 advertising POSTER for SHIELDTRAC SECURITY. CREATIVE DIRECTION: warm relatable CONTEMPORARY MODERN AFRICAN lifestyle advertising. Attractive well-maintained contemporary Zimbabwean settings and current professional equipment. Do NOT signal Africa through dilapidation, old broken buildings, poverty, dusty neglected streets, colonial nostalgia or safari clichés. Modern contemporary Zimbabwean urban life: attractive current homes with landscaped entrances, clean modern retail storefronts, contemporary offices with glass reception areas, modern apartment lobbies, orderly new construction sites. Black African business owners, families, adult security professionals and technicians in present-day attire. Guards wear smart plain navy uniforms without weapons or police badges. Warm respectful interactions. No exposed security codes, actual addresses, camera diagrams, operational screens or response-time claims. Topic: "Protection starts with a plan.". Invent a visually specific authentic scene about THIS topic, informed by: Guarding and patrol enquiries; CCTV and alarm systems; Discuss monitoring and response requirements. Candid medium-wide human interaction with contemporary environment as part of the story, airy editorial headline space. Natural skin, anatomically correct hands, unforced expression, premium southern African lifestyle photography, gorgeous warm daylight. Photo occupies at least 70% of poster. Sophisticated deep navy, warm cream, orange accents and cream negative space, strong readable editorial typography. Brand at top as small PLAIN TYPESET text "SHIELDTRAC SECURITY", no invented logo. Main headline EXACTLY "Your business. Your people. Worth looking after.". Short service line "Guarding • CCTV • Alarm systems". Footer CTA "Let’s discuss your requirements." then "+263 788 094 724" and "shieldtrac.co.zw". Very small "Illustrative image". No other text, checklists, day/month numbers, badges, fake reviews, ratings, certifications, invented offers or guarantees. Models and scenes are fictional illustrative advertising, not documentary customer work. Distinctive visually memorable commercial design, not a repeated text card or stiff corporate stock image.
